newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen up after PPI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen up after PPI.

text.p: U.S. stocks were seen opening higher on Wednesday after a lower-than-expected report on the April Producer Price Index, analysts said.
Producer prices posted their biggest decline in nearly four years, tumbling by 0.6 percent as food and energy costs declined, the Labor Department said.
The data, indicating inflation is under control, means U.S. stocks could rally on hopes the Federal Open Market Committee will leave interest rates untouched at its Tuesday meeting.
